jobs.title: Factory smoke test (chat lane)
jobs.plain: Checks what a normal ChatGPT chat can do (save files, open PRs, screenshots).

jobs.title: Factory smoke test (Work lane)
jobs.plain: Checks what Sol Work mode can do (terminal, npm, Firebase emulator).

jobs.title: Fast regression CI on every gameplay push
jobs.plain: GitHub runs every gameplay test automatically on each worker save.

jobs.title: Two-manager journey on the emulator (provider level)
jobs.plain: Daniel and Nik play a whole Showdown against the real Rules in a test database, with a stranger and privacy checks.

jobs.title: Simultaneous result taps: loser gets stale, not denied
jobs.plain: When you both submit a result at once, the slower tap is told to refresh instead of getting an error.

jobs.title: Two-manager browser journey (localhost-only emulator switch)
jobs.plain: The same journey through the real app screens in a browser, test database only.

jobs.title: Composed production Rules regression
jobs.plain: Re-proves the full production Rules after the new career-data Rules land.

jobs.title: Pure shared career model + tests
jobs.plain: One pure function that turns Showdown data into the career numbers every screen shows.

jobs.title: Active Showdown adapter (Rivalry, Continue, tiebreak, final state)
jobs.plain: Live Showdown (Rivalry, Continue, tiebreak, final result) feeds the career model.

jobs.title: Renderer seams: screens take a model, never the local path
jobs.plain: Screens read from that career model instead of from one phone's local data.

jobs.title: Start/Join view model + nav.locked
jobs.plain: Start/Join screen and top-bar locking driven by one view model.

jobs.title: Contract fixtures generated from the real model
jobs.plain: Example data for Team V generated from the real model, so visuals and gameplay agree.

jobs.title: Career index Rules + client + emulator proofs
jobs.plain: A shared list of every Showdown the two of you played, protected by Rules.

jobs.title: Completed-only read grant + session-free reader
jobs.plain: Finished Showdowns stay readable for both managers after they close.

jobs.title: Closed-Showdown adapter into the career model
jobs.plain: Finished Showdowns flow into career totals and the Trophy Room.

jobs.title: Transfer history, completed only
jobs.plain: Transfer history visible only once a challenge is completed.

jobs.title: Remove the r43 containment, bind #trophyRoomButton
jobs.plain: Turns on the Trophy Room button and the new career screens with Team V's approved visuals.

jobs.title: Acceptance: directive §12 and Sol's 8 proofs on the emulator
jobs.plain: Final acceptance run of every promised behaviour in the test database.

jobs.title: One real two-device run with Nik
jobs.plain: One real game on two phones with Daniel, to sign it off.

jobs.title: Nik's pair code survives the pair-panel re-render
jobs.plain: When Nik pastes Daniel's code quickly, the app keeps it instead of wiping it and wrongly calling it invalid.
